caseName: Hollywood Baseball Association v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue
caseNameFull: Hollywood Baseball Association v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Arthur E. Gore for petitioner., Solicitor General Marshall, Acting Assistant Attorney General Roberts and Harry Baum for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The petition for a writ of certiorari is granted. The judgment of the Court of Appeals is vacated and the case is remanded to that court for further consideration in light of Malat v. Riddell, ante, p. 569.
